title: DesignRevision
description: A versioned design artifact submitted for review. Immutable once approved.

revisionId.description: Unique identifier for this design revision (DES-R<N> format)

workItemId.description: Work item this revision belongs to

parentRevisionId.description: Parent revision ID for lineage (null for root revision)

designSystemRevision.description: Design system revision this revision targets

boardIdsJson.description: JSON array of board IDs in the design file

responsiveTargetsJson.description: JSON array of responsive breakpoints targeted

statesRepresentedJson.description: JSON array of UI states represented (default, hover, focus, etc.)

designerExecutionId.description: Agent execution that produced this revision

reviewExecutionIdsJson.description: JSON array of review execution IDs

status.description: Current status in the review lifecycle

reviewScopeJson.description: Optional structured review scope (subset of design contract)

carriedForwardFromRevisionId.description: Revision from which findings were carried forward

supersededByRevisionId.description: Revision that supersedes this one (if applicable)

approvedAt.description: Timestamp when revision was approved (if applicable)

version.description: Optimistic locking version for CAS updates
